full_judgment: 10. Mr. Akram Hossain Amin, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioners, submitted that the judgment and order passed by the appellate court is not a proper judgment of reversal inasmuch as the order has been passed without adverting any cogent finding and reason given by the trial court. The learned Advocate for the petitioners further submits the Court of Appeal below erred in holding that the summons of suit was not served upon the opposite parties. That the learned Advocate for the petitioners further submits that the long delay in filing the Miscellaneous Case has not been sufficiently explained by the defendants. That learned Advocate for the petitioners further submits that the Miscellaneous Case under Order 9 Rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure is not maintainable when the suit was decreed on compromise. He further submits that the learned Sub-Judge committed an error of law resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice in holding that summons and notices were not duly served upon the opposite parties.
